cds.title: Slippery Rock University Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF)

navigator.title: IPEDS / College Navigator - Slippery Rock University of Pennsylvania

stats.notes: CDS C1: international first-year applicants 228, admitted 81 (36%), enrolled 6, far below the 74% overall admit rate, so SRU is not an automatic admit for international applicants; the CDS does not say why (for example incomplete applications). C2 says no waitlist policy, while SRU's admissions page describes a waitlist for applicants below the guidelines. 12% (178 students) of enrolled first-years submitted SAT; the CDS prints ACT as 0% with 30 students, so pct_submit_act is left null. SAT/ACT percentiles are for those submitters only (ACT: 30 students). C7 marks test scores 'important' although applications are test-optional. GPA distribution is the all-enrolled column of C11 (3.58 average). Undergraduate enrollment 7,088 and 248 nonresident undergraduates are CDS B1/B2 (fall 2025).

cds_test_policy.notes: CDS C8A (Fall 2027): SAT or ACT 'not required for admission, but considered if submitted'.

cost.notes: CDS H6: 62 undergraduate degree-seeking nonresidents received institutional aid, average $1,775 (total $110,038); the CDS text does not show whether it was need- or non-need-based. CDS G1 for 2026-27 lists tuition $7,994 in-state and $11,992 out-of-state/nonresident, required fees $3,470, food and housing $11,098; the international cost matrix is used for the cost figures.
